website.note: Pipeline shown as image only; no parseable text. Per 10-K, no active clinical programs.

ctgov.note: All Alaunos-sponsored trials are COMPLETED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, SUSPENDED or UNKNOWN. The TCR-T Library trial NCT05194735 (P1/2 solid tumors) was TERMINATED 2023-08-14 alongside strategic reprioritization.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Alaunos discontinued all clinical TCR-T programs in August 2023 (strategic reprioritization, ~95% workforce reduction). The TCR-T Library Phase 1/2 trial at MD Anderson (NCT05194735) was terminated. As of the FY2025 10-K (filed March 2026), Alaunos is a preclinical-stage company developing an internally discovered, oral, small-molecule, non-hormonal anti-obesity / MASLD candidate (ALN1003); no IND filed. Cash ~$1.4M as of Dec 31 2025 with runway only into Q2 2026.
excluded_preclinical: ALN1003 — oral non-hormonal small molecule for obesity / MASLD; positive DIO mouse proof-of-concept announced March 2026; IND-enabling studies planned but no IND filed
excluded_legacy_terminated: Ad-RTS-hIL-12 + veledimex glioblastoma program (multiple NCTs incl. NCT04006119, NCT03330197, NCT02423902, NCT01703754) — all TERMINATED
Palifosfamide (ZIO-201) sarcoma/SCLC program (NCT01168791 P3 COMPLETED neg, NCT01555710 MATISSE P3 UNKNOWN, etc.)
Darinaparsin (ZIO-101) and Indibulin (ZIO-301) legacy oncology programs — all completed/unknown
